summary: This is a foreign private issuer report (Form 6-K) by Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A., the target company, disclosing that Holcim Ltd. has requested an exemption from Peru's securities regulator (SMV) to proceed with a tender offer (OPA) for up to 100% of the remaining common shares not owned by its subsidiary Inversiones ASPI S.A., which holds a controlling interest. The tender offer follows Holcim's earlier indirect acquisition of control, announced March 30 and May 14, 2026. Holcim seeks to use its 99.99%-owned subsidiary as offeror and to submit audited FY2025 consolidated statements and unaudited interim June 2026 statements. No price, premium, or timeline is stated. Watch for SMV ruling on exemption and subsequent tender offer terms.
